scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
